description: This file defines the JsonObject interface, representing an immutable JSON object with methods for creation, modification, retrieval, and manipulation of JSON data structures within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: JsonObject
classes.description: Interface representing an immutable JSON object with methods for creation, modification, and data access.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject from a JSON string.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for constructing JsonObject instances.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder initialized with the current JsonObject data for modifications.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Creates a new JsonObject with a specified key and value of various types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue).

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field based on a JsonFieldDefinition or JsonField.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple fields to the JsonObject.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key or JSON pointer exists in the object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a sub-object or value based on a JSON pointer, field definition, or field selector.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a key or JSON pointer as an Optional.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a field definition, throws if missing.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a field specified by a key or JSON pointer.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns a list of all keys in document order.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the JsonField object for a given key.
